settings.label: Logo (optional)
settings.info: Upload only images you own or have licensed. No supplier/competitor photos. Before/after only from real, consenting customers, unedited.

settings.label: Blush red (icons, large UI only)
settings.info: White text on this blush red is about 3.3:1 and fails AA for body text. Use it for icons and large shapes only.

settings.label: Blush red deep (text, buttons)
settings.info: Used for text links and buttons with white text (about 6:1).

settings.label: Butter yellow (highlights, use with ink text)

settings.content: These links fill the header menu. Leave a label empty to hide that link. If every label is empty, the store's Main menu (Online Store > Navigation) is used instead. Home page anchors work from every page.

One link per line, written as: Text | address. Use the word email as the address to open an email to your support address. Leave a column title empty to hide that column. Only link pages that really exist.
